title: Give the Rook Away
setup: Black's king is on f2 right beside your rook on g1, with a bishop on e7 and a rook on g8 still defending.
hint: Your rook is attacked and the king is next to it. Ask what happens if it is allowed to take it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qd2+}} leaves the king nothing better than {{Kxg1}} — the king walks into the corner to collect. {{Qh2+}} seals h2 and {{Rd1#}} mates down the file the queen vacated. The best hunting move often hands over the piece the king wants.
